info.title: Universal VPS Root Shell
info.description: Authenticated universal remote VPS root shell. It can install or use software and run arbitrary non-interactive workflows; installed tools are not a capability boundary. Large command output can be returned as GPT Action file attachments instead of oversized inline JSON.

command.description: Any shell command or multiline script to execute with /bin/bash -lc. Multiple dependent steps may be combined into one script.

workdir.description: Optional absolute or relative host working directory. Defaults to /root. It is not restricted to a repository workspace.

stdin.description: Optional standard input passed to the command. Useful for non-interactive CLI input, scripts, payloads and file content.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional per-workflow timeout in seconds. It may shorten but cannot exceed the server-side COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS limit.

status.description: completed means exit code 0; a non-zero command exit is failed. Cancellation and timeout have distinct terminal states.

exit_code.description: Null while running; process exit code after completion.

stdout.description: Complete stdout for terminal jobs when it fits; otherwise a live or terminal preview.

stderr.description: Complete stderr for terminal jobs when it fits; otherwise a live or terminal preview.

truncated.description: For running snapshots, true when the current response omits output. For terminal jobs, true only when some command output was actually lost.

inline_truncated.description: True when stdout/stderr in this JSON are only a preview. For terminal results, use openaiFileResponse for the complete output.

revision.description: Monotonic job revision. Pass the last seen value as after to wait for the next change.

openaiFileResponse.description: Complete command output files returned through the GPT Actions file-response mechanism when inline JSON would be too large. Up to 10 text files may be returned.

full_output_attached.description: True when the attached files contain all command output even if inline stdout/stderr are previews.

capture_truncated.description: True only when command output exceeded the attachment capture capacity; false means attached output is complete.

output_file_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of the unguessable attachment URLs.

stdout.description: Complete inline stdout when it fits; otherwise a small preview while full output is attached.

stderr.description: Complete inline stderr when it fits; otherwise a small preview while full output is attached.

truncated.description: True only when some command output was actually lost. False when complete output is inline or preserved in attached files.

inline_truncated.description: True when stdout/stderr in this JSON are only a preview. For terminal results, use openaiFileResponse for the complete output.

openaiFileResponse.description: Complete command output files returned through the GPT Actions file-response mechanism when inline JSON would be too large. Up to 10 text files may be returned.

full_output_attached.description: True when the attached files contain all command output even if inline stdout/stderr are previews.

capture_truncated.description: True only when command output exceeded the attachment capture capacity; false means attached output is complete.

output_file_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of the unguessable attachment URLs.

post.summary: Run a root shell workflow on the remote VPS
post.description: Runs a non-interactive root shell workflow via /bin/bash -lc. Use for short work. GPT Actions time out long requests; prefer startCommand for long work. Oversized stdout/stderr is returned as attached text files.

200.description: Workflow finished. Large output may be delivered through openaiFileResponse attachments instead of oversized inline JSON.

500.description: The shell could not be started or the requested workdir is unavailable.

post.summary: Start a long-running root shell workflow
post.description: Starts a root shell workflow independently of the HTTP request and immediately returns a job id. Prefer for long work; observe it with revision-based getCommandJob long polling.

202.description: Job accepted. Use getCommandJob to poll until it reaches a terminal state.

get.description: Returns a job snapshot. Use revision-based long polling while running. Terminal output is returned inline when safe, or as GPT Action text-file attachments when too large for one JSON payload.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last revision already seen. If it still matches a running job, wait for a change instead of polling immediately.

parameters.name: wait_seconds
parameters.description: Long-poll wait when after matches. Defaults to 10 seconds when after is supplied; maximum 20 seconds. Zero returns immediately.

parameters.name: tail_chars
parameters.description: Return only the newest N Unicode characters from each output stream. Long-poll requests default to 12000; ordinary snapshots return the full stored rolling output.

200.description: Current job snapshot. Terminal large output may include openaiFileResponse attachments containing the complete captured output.

post.description: Requests cancellation of a running job and its process group. Completed jobs are left unchanged.
